turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail: Message from YETI Virtual Outfitter: Orders are dispatched from our warehouse in Truganina, Victoria, with delivery handled by StarTrack, Australia Post, or CouriersPlease. You’ll receive tracking details in the shipping and tracking notification once your order is dispatched. If your order status is Pending, the tracking number can take 24–48 hours to become available. Processing and dispatch times may vary during busy periods, and delivery transit times depend on the carrier and your location.
